PGDATA.description: Filesystem path where PostgreSQL stores its data files.

PGHOST.description: PostgreSQL server hostname on the private network.

PGUSER.description: PostgreSQL username used in connection strings.

PGDATABASE.description: PostgreSQL database name used in connection strings.

PGPASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL password used in connection strings.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Default database name created on initialization.

DATABASE_URL.description: Internal PostgreSQL connection URL for service-to-service communication.

SSL_CERT_DAYS.description: Number of days until the auto-generated SSL certificate expires.

DATABASE_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public PostgreSQL connection URL via TCP proxy for external access.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds to wait before stopping the previous deployment during a rollout.

REDISHOST.description: Redis server hostname on the private network.

REDIS_URL.description: Internal Redis connection URL for service-to-service communication.

REDIS_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public Redis connection URL via TCP proxy for external access.

NODE_ENV.description: Node.js runtime environment. Use production for deployed instances.

NODE_OPTIONS.description: Node.js runtime flags. Suppresses localStorage warnings on newer Node versions.

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection URL. References the managed postgres service.

REDIS_URL.description: Redis connection URL. References the managed redis service.

SECRET_KEY.description: Secret key for encrypting sessions and cookies. Auto-generated; do not change after first deploy.

UTILS_SECRET.description: Secret used for utility operations and background tasks. Auto-generated; do not change after first deploy.

URL.description: Public URL of your Outline instance. Uses the Railway-generated domain.

PORT.description: HTTP port for the Outline web server. Set automatically by Railway.

FORCE_HTTPS.description: Redirect HTTP requests to HTTPS. Should remain enabled in production.

FILE_STORAGE.description: File storage backend. Use local storage with the attached volume.

FILE_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT_DIR.description: Directory path for locally stored uploads and attachments.

DEFAULT_LANGUAGE.description: Default language for the Outline user interface.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Google OAuth client ID. Required for sign-in. See https://docs.getoutline.com/s/hosting/doc/google-hOuvtCmTqQ

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Google OAuth client secret. Required for sign-in.

SMTP_SERVICE.description: SMTP service for transactional emails (optional). See https://docs.getoutline.com/s/hosting/doc/smtp-cqCJyZGMIB

OIDC_CLIENT_ID.description: OpenID Connect client ID (optional alternative auth). See https://docs.getoutline.com/s/hosting/doc/oidc-8CPBm6uC0I

SLACK_CLIENT_ID.description: Slack OAuth client ID (optional alternative auth). See https://docs.getoutline.com/s/hosting/doc/slack-sgMujR8J9J
